# Field blocks for Saxony, Germany

Germany, Saxony field boundaries (2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Sächsisches Landesamt für Umwelt, Landwirtschaft und Geologie. License: DL-DE-BY-2.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sax/latest/de_sax.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sax/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:25833; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: FB_BEZEICH, WT_WRRL, FB_SPA, REG_SAAT, GLOEZ2, BERG, AGROFORST, metrics:area, AGRIPV, NITRAT_TG, KWASSER, FB_FFH, FB_BN_KAT, ZUSTAENDIG, OER_UNZUL, NITRAT, KWIND, FB_NB, flik, geometry, id, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sax/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sax/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sax/collection.json
